lines.text: God tells Moses to bring Aaron and his four sons to serve as priests, and to have skilled craftsmen make holy garments.
Two onyx stones engraved with the names of the sons of Israel are fastened on the ephod's shoulder pieces.
The round breastpiece holds four rows of gemstones, twelve in all, each engraved with the name of one tribe.
Aaron's blue robe has gold bells and pomegranates around the hem, and its sound is heard when he enters the sanctuary.
A gold plate engraved THE LORD IS ONE is fastened with a blue cord on the front of Aaron's turban.
